I hired Magnum Detective Agency to conduct a background check on a woman my close friend was considering marrying through arrange marriage. While communicating with the girl, the guy felt mismatch in many words of  her which led to this hiring of detective agency. Unfortunately, our experience with Magnum Detective Agency was profoundly disappointing and a complete waste of money.

Firstly, the detectives did not perform a thorough investigation. They did not visit her workplace or home. Instead, they provided us with photos of her house that were easily found on Google and stated it was clicked by their secret agent when they visited her place. It was evident that these images were downloaded from the internet, which was highly unprofessional and misleading. Their report claimed they spoke to someone in the woman's area, but it was apparent that they did not put in any genuine effort. The report was a generic write-up, stating she was good, calm, composed, and had no prior affairs. They mentioned she was working in a certain position which Is a permanent job, but this information was also inaccurate.

Due to the lack of trust in their findings especially because of google photos, we started our own investigation and uncovered starkly different information. The woman was not permanently employed at the company as claimed. She was merely doing some administrative work for a few hours, thanks to a connection between her father and the company's owner. More importantly, she had a serious affair and admitted that she still had feelings for the other guy when confronted later with proof. None of this crucial information was provided by Magnum Detective Agency. It seems they survive by giving standard, positive reviews about individuals to avoid raising questions. They did not perform their duties despite charging a substantial fee and this could have ruined someone's life. I think all these reviews are fake and by their own known people or maybe people didnt realize they are not doing their job correctly as they would have given positive reviews. Save your money and find a more reliable agency that will take your concerns seriously and provide accurate, detailed information.
